scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @asterbyte/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,api,web "npm run dev --workspace @asterbyte/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @asterbyte/api" "npm run dev --workspace @asterbyte/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @asterbyte/contracts && npm run build --workspace @asterbyte/api && npm run build --workspace @asterbyte/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @asterbyte/contracts && tsc -p scripts/database/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @asterbyte/contracts && npm run test:database && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
